Quotes / Liang Shuming / Q0481

English

Attitudes toward life are basically three: striving forward, holding the mean in harmony, and turning back inward.
Thinker Liang Shuming
School Modern New Confucianism
Source Eastern and Western Cultures and Their Philosophies
Theme Society
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Eastern and Western Cultures and Their Philosophies, within the tradition of Modern New Confucianism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of society, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Liang Shuming's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
